Aldra is the reigning queen and victor of the past two Queen's Blade tournaments. Born from the Pope—the highest religious leader—and the granddaughter of the Devil King of the Netherworld, she is a cursed half-demon who serves as one of the central antagonists of the Queen's Blade series alongside Elina Vance.

Appearance[]

Queen's Blade[]

Aldra wears a cat ear-like headband and a metal eye patch covering her right eye. Her bright red outfit features belts across the top, with spikes protruding from the pauldron on her left arm. Her lower body is protected by red hip armor, and she wears a hidden blade set that functions as her undergarment. She wears red thigh-highs with interlaced bands featuring a beast engraving on her upper thighs, along with metal heels with long spikes on the toe and heel. She wears a barbed codpiece on her crotch that resembles a phallus, similar to Luna Luna's tentacle.

Rebellion[]

In Rebellion, Aldra wears a red cat ear-like headband and a white apron with a red ribbon around the middle. Her left arm is protected by a golden full-length arm-guard, while her right arm is covered by a red sleeve. She wears white thigh-high boots with red diamond designs and light purple lace panties.

Unlimited[]

In Unlimited, Aldra wears a long red dress and lacks the codpiece from her original incarnation. Her sleeves, waist, and boots are armored. Her eye color has changed from red to green, and she no longer wears the cat-ear headband. Her sword has been redesigned with a curved edge and saw-like blade, replacing the angular blade. The grip has changed from a knuckle duster to a traditional handle, with an eye-like gem adorning the crossguard.

Personality[]

Queen's Blade[]

Aldra appears cold and emotionless, driven only to see her opponents defeated. However, this is not her true personality but rather that of Delmore, the demon she made a pact with several years ago.

Rebellion[]

In Rebellion, Aldra has a cheerful personality. She remembers nothing from her past except the desire to find her sister, and has started a new life completely devoted to her husband.

Unlimited[]

In Unlimited, Aldra's personality reflects her transformation. With her left arm unsealed and Delmore now a female entity, her demeanor has shifted to match her enhanced power and status.

Abilities[]

Queen's Blade[]

Using Delmore's power, Aldra possesses "petrifying gaze" and "flesh-rending secret" abilities. She can capture opponents in amber-like stone, which she collects as trophies, and can also summon one-eyed, bat-like creatures called "Minions." She is a skilled fighter, having maintained her position as Queen for two terms, though this may be attributed to Delmore's power.

Rebellion[]

Aldra fights with her gondolier's paddle and uses Belphe and Dogor in battle. Belphe can hold objects or breathe fire, while Dogor generates an extremely potent acidic liquid capable of burning through metal. Both summons plot to devour their contractor given the opportunity.

Unlimited[]

In Unlimited, Aldra's abilities have been significantly enhanced. With her left arm unsealed, she can access the full extent of her demonic power. She has gained wings and a tail, fully manifesting her demonic heritage, and Delmore has transformed into a female entity, with their partnership evolving accordingly.

Story[]

Prior to QB[]

(From the Queen's Blade site)

Aldra is the current Queen who has won the last two Queen's Blade tournaments in a row.

She is a cursed half-demon, born from the Pope—the highest-level religious leader of the earthly world—and the daughter of the Devil King of the Netherworld.

Eight years ago, she summoned the demon Delmore and made a contract, receiving powers beyond human knowledge, including the petrifying demon eye and the flesh-rending secret blade. From that point, her body stopped developing. After becoming Queen, she strengthened military control and the assassination units, crushing opposition through might and power, and sealed her left arm for fear of unleashing her full power.

During her nomadic childhood, she was separated from her newborn sister, who was everything to her. Searching for her sister, she became Queen to live a worry-free life, though she found no clues about her sister. The court sorcerers predicted her sister's death but hid this from the Queen, fearing her reaction, and stalled for time, hoping she would be defeated in the next tournament.

Smart and possessing great political might, her government maintains a high approval rating among the population.

Unable to accomplish her goal, the Queen began to go insane from using demonic power for so long. The high statesman noticed this and showed her a blank sheet of paper, telling her it was a letter from her sister who wished to meet but could not come for several reasons.

Delmore gave Aldra her power under the condition of being tied to her for the rest of her life. His worst mistake was falling in love with her, since he can do nothing in the earthly world but heal Aldra's wounds and whisper words of love. He has not told her, but a demon who loves a person cannot return to the Netherworld and will be destroyed when their loved one dies.

Original Prologue[]

(From her backcover)

A huge arena towered over the capital of Gainos.

The place where the Queen's Blade fight that decided the throne unfolded. Decorating the arena was a countless group of stone statues of female fighters with agonizing expressions on their faces—statues that were not made by any carver.

By the power of our Demon Eye, we can turn those who are alive into a statue. When we want to be lost in thought, away from the aides of the nagging Imperial Court, we come here and polish the stone statues.

"Beautiful Aldra. Your lovely eyes full of sorrow seem to be sucking me in."

The name of this man approaching us spewing corny lines is Delmore.

We made a contract with this evil spirit to obtain the power of the Netherworld.

His price was to "spend eternity together."

Though we usually leave him alone because he isn't particularly harmful, sometimes he can get quite annoying.

The reason why we had to become Queen, why we needed to gain strength, that's…

"You're worried about your sister, Aldra."

Our beloved sister. That's everything to us.

It had been a lifelong separation for more than eight years, and though we've kept looking for her, we haven't found her in the end.

Letters and gifts from her have arrived, though, so we're certain that she's alive somewhere.

We'll use up all the power we have as a Queen, and we'll meet our younger sister by all means!

Therefore, we'll keep winning, we must continue being the Queen.

Tomorrow will finally be the tournament's finals. That will be when the fool who challenges us and decorates this arena will be decided…

Sure enough, can Aldra achieve three consecutive victories in the tournament?

They won't know that unless they fight.

Prior to Rebellion[]

(From the Queen's Blade site)

Aldra is the half-demon who once won two successive Queen's Blade championships and ruled as "The Queen."

In the last tournament, the demon Delmore—the source of her extraordinary powers—was torn from her, and she was defeated. By losing most of her powers, her body, which had stopped growing, reverted to its true form.

Afterward, she embarked on a journey to find her lost sister but suffered memory loss.

What saved the physically and mentally exhausted Aldra was the love from a certain man. They married, and Aldra's heart was healed.

A short-lived happy life began before the war between the Queen's Army and the Rebel Army spread throughout the Continent. To protect her beloved husband, she was determined to throw herself into the fight, using her innate summoning skills again to summon and make a contract with the Netherworld dwellers Belphe and Dogor. However, these two are a dangerous threat and plot to devour their contractor Aldra when they get the chance.

Rebellion Prologue[]

(From her backcover)

Hey, darling, wake up.

Geez, you're already oversleeping.

Kiss.

Ah, you woke up.

Good morning, darling.

Geez, to wake the other up with a kiss is the role of the prince!


I made breakfast. Your favorite rice dish.

Though it was a little expensive, since I received a lot of tips from the regular customers yesterday, every once in a while…


Eh, what kind of people are my customers, you say?

Oh my, are you jealous?

Though I understand. Al is crazy about you. Only for you.

Geez, don't make me say such a thing in the morning, how embarrassing…


Hey, darling.

I have something important to tell you.

I will be going away for a while.

I'm sorry, please don't ask me why.

But one thing is for sure. I'm leaving for our sake.


You, who saved me when I had lost it all, are the most precious to me.

And, you're all I have now.

To protect you, I...

Knock, knock!

"Mada~m, how long will you keep us waiting? I have no more patience!"

"Hohoho, isn't it fine? At any rate, we'll have ple~nty of time from now on. Let's do this carefully, ca~refully, right?"


Geez, I have to go. Sorry for the sudden departure.

Then, I'm leaving, darling.


Sure enough, for the sake of protecting the husband she loves, can Aldra win using the wicked summoned beasts?


They won't know that unless they fight.

Trivia[]

  • Aldra is only shown and heard speaking twice in the entirety of Queen's Blade: Wandering Warrior.
  • Aldra won two Queen's Blade Tournaments; she was twelve years old when she became Queen, making her the youngest Queen ever in the history of the Continent.
  • Even though Aldra is said to have fallen in love and gotten married, no one has really seen her husband. Based on her Rebellion prologue being written in the second person, this seems to subtly indicate that her husband is the reader (breaking the fourth wall slightly).
  • She is voiced by Miyu Takeuchi (Japanese) in the original series and the videogames, Ayana Taketatsu (Japanese) in Rebellion, and Kenzi Brooke (English).
  • Her summons, Belphe (the pink one) and Dogor (the green one), are a play on the name of the demon Belphegor.
